mapper.select: select sabun, date_format(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, date_format(checkin, '%H:%i:%s') as checkin, date_format(checkout, '%H:%i:%s') as checkout from ta where sabun = #{sabun} and date(day) = curdate()
mapper.insert: insert into ta(sabun, day, checkin) values(#{sabun}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update ta set checkout = now() where sabun = #{sabun} and date(day) = curdate()
mapper.select: select sabun, date_format(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, date_format(checkin, '%H:%i:%s') as checkin, date_format(checkout, '%H:%i:%s') as checkout from ta where sabun = #{sabun} order by day desc

WITH RECURSIVE calendar AS ( SELECT DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01')) AS day UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM calendar WHERE day < DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-12-31')) ) SELECT s.sabun, s.saname, s.sahire, s.deptno, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (t.day IS NULL OR t.checkin IS NULL AND t.checkout IS NULL) AND sl.use_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absentCount, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND t.checkout IS NOT NULL THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(t.checkout, t.checkin)) / 3600 END), 0 ), 1 ) AS totalWorkTime FROM calendar c JOIN sawon s ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = s.sabun AND t.day = c.day LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON sl.sabun = s.sabun AND sl.use_date = c.day AND sl.approve = true WHERE DAYOFWEEK(c.day) NOT IN (1, 7) AND c.day <= CURDATE() AND s.deptno = #{deptno} GROUP BY s.sabun, s.saname, s.sahire, s.deptno ORDER BY s.deptno, s.sabun

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, -- 정상 출근
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, -- 지각
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true AND sl.use_days = 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS halfCount, -- 반차
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true AND sl.use_days = 1 THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, -- 연차
COUNT(CASE WHEN t.checkin IS NULL AND t.checkout IS NULL AND sl.use_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absentCount -- 결근
FROM sawon s LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = s.sabun AND t.day = CURDATE() -- 오늘 날짜만 LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON sl.sabun = s.sabun AND sl.approve = true AND sl.use_date = CURDATE() -- 오늘 날짜만

SELECT s.sabun, s.saname,
-- 1. 출근일수: checkin(출근시간)이 찍힌 날의 총 개수를 구합니다. COUNT(ta.checkin) AS worked_days,
-- 2. 결근일수: 우선 0으로 던지고 자바 서비스단에서 (기준일수 - 출근일수)로 계산합니다. 0 AS absence_days,
-- 3. 총 연장근무 시간 계산 -- [원리] 퇴근시간과 출근시간의 차이(분 단위)를 구한 뒤, 기본근무 8시간(480분)을 뺀 나머지를 시간 단위로 환산합니다. IFNULL( SUM( CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ta.checkin, ta.checkout) > 480 THEN (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ta.checkin, ta.checkout) - 480) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS overtime_hours
FROM sawon s -- 해당 년월(예: 2026-06)의 근태 데이터만 매핑 LEFT JOIN ta ta ON s.sabun = ta.sabun AND ta.day LIKE CONCAT(#{ym}, '%') GROUP BY s.sabun, s.saname
